cr_data.provenance: Private collection, Santa Fe, New Mexico, gift, 1975; Grete Meilman Fine Art, Ltd., New York, NY, and Zaplin-Lampert Gallery, Santa Fe, New Mexico, 1989 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Not recorded Whitney Archive, Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks. See cat. nos. 661–64, 666, 703–5. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

description: A low wall meets a taller building, forming an L-shape at the center of this minimalist composition. Another rectangular wall protrudes from the building, just behind the low wall. The structure and background have delicate shading throughout. Exposed white paper surrounds the image.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
title: Untitled (Ranchos Church)
